text:
### Observed differences

- A05 and A10 exchanged their participation roles. In the earlier window A05 ran in every trace (about 4.2 occurrences per trace) while A10 ran in about 46 in 100 traces (about 1.9 occurrences); in the later window A10 runs in every trace (about 4.1 occurrences) while A05 runs in about 50 in 100 traces (about 2.2 occurrences). [OCC004, OCC008]
- Repetition moved with them: observed repeated pairs within five steps fell for A05–A05 (153 to 77) and A08–A08 (89 to 42) and rose for A10–A10 (64 to 149) and A16–A16 (34 to 87). [LAG001, LAG006, LAG009, LAG023]
- Routing into this block changed. Earlier A06 always continued to A05, later always to A10; A11 shifted from about 49 in 100 of its outgoing transitions to A05 to about 54 in 100 to A10; A15 shifted from about 51 in 100 to A05 to about 46 in 100 to A10; A14's dominant successor changed from A10 (about 51 in 100) to A05 (about 53 in 100). [DIR004, DIR008, DIR010, DIR011]
- The branches under the two hubs exchanged children. A05's observed outgoing transitions went to A08 (about 52 in 100) or A09 (about 48) earlier and to A17 (about 52) or A08 (about 48) later; A10's went to A17 (about 54) or A16 (about 46) earlier and to A16 (about 52) or A09 (about 48) later — A09 accounts for none of A05's roughly 440 observed outgoing transitions later, and A17 for none of A10's roughly 820. [DIR003, DIR007]
- Co-occurrence matches this rewiring. Earlier A05 always co-occurred with A09, A11, A14 and A15; later it co-occurs with each in only about 50 in 100 traces, while A10 now always co-occurs with them. The A05–A10 pair flipped from "A05 without A10" in about 54 in 100 traces to "A10 without A05" in about 50 in 100. A08's share halved to about 34 in 100 traces (it still occurs only alongside A05), and A16's share more than doubled to about 68 in 100 (it still occurs only alongside A10). [REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL019, REL025, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, OCC006, OCC012]
- Positions and step gaps mirror the exchange: A05's mean relative position moved from about 0.67 to 0.33 of the trace and A08's from about 0.66 to 0.34, while A10's moved from about 0.32 to 0.67 and A16's from about 0.33 to 0.67; the A14→A05 gap shifted from around 3 steps to around 1, the A14→A10 gap from around 1 step to 3–5, and A14→A16 pairs now sit almost entirely at 4 steps. [POS001, POS003, POS005, POS009, LAG013, LAG015, LAG018]
- Elsewhere the process is stable: A01 (about 4.2 occurrences per trace, in every trace), A09 (about 2 per trace, in every trace), A07's split across A02, A12 and A03, and the roughly 50-in-100 participations of A02, A03 and A12 show only differences within the range of random window-to-window variation. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC007, OCC009, DIR005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A05 and A10 exchanged places in the control flow, taking their branch children with them: in the later window A10 is the mandatory, roughly four-times-repeated hub into which A06, A11, A14 and A15 route and which continues to A16 or A09, while A05 became an optional block present in about half of the traces with about two occurrences, reached from A14 and continuing to A17 or A08; A09 moved from A05's branch to A10's and A17 from A10's branch to A05's, while A08 and A16 stayed attached to A05 and A10 respectively. [OCC004, OCC008, DIR003, DIR004, DIR007, DIR008, DIR010, DIR011, REL004, REL025]

This is shown directly, not merely through frequency shifts: the successor replacements are observed relationally (A06 always continues to A10 instead of A05; A09 disappears from A05's observed transitions and appears under A10), and the participation, co-occurrence, position and step-gap items all describe this one rewiring rather than independent phenomena; the differences exceed those of about 995 in 1000 random re-splits of these 200-trace windows. [DIR004, DIR007, OCC004, OCC008, POS001, POS005, LAG013, LAG015]

The evidence cannot establish whether this was one coordinated exchange of the two blocks or separate re-routings of entry and exit points that produce the same pattern, and a shifted mix of process variants cannot be fully ruled out — although the complete replacement of successors (for example A14 is never observed continuing to A10 afterwards) argues against a simple variant mix. [DIR007, DIR010]

Other differences: only minor fluctuations remain, within the range random re-splits of these windows produce — A06 participation about 51 to 49 in 100 traces, A13 mean occurrences about 2.13 to 2.05, slightly later mean positions for A11 and A15, and redistributed self-gaps for A06 and A09. [OCC005, OCC010, POS006, POS008, LAG003, LAG008]
